description: This file contains Python code defining classes and functions for generating C++ code related to JSON schema objects, enums, and restrictions, including methods for emitting code, handling enums, and managing object properties.

classes.name: Restrictions
classes.description: A class for managing and evaluating schema restrictions and conditions, such as range checks, null checks, and set checks, used for validation purposes.

methods.name: IsObjectRestricted
methods.description: Checks if a JSON object or its properties have a 'range' schema restriction.

methods.name: IsObjectOptionalOrOpaque
methods.description: Determines if an argument is optional or opaque based on schema and parent properties.

methods.name: IsObjectOptional
methods.description: Checks if an argument is optional, considering nested properties.

methods.name: ProcessEnums
methods.description: Processes enum objects, optionally applying an action to each.

methods.name: EmitEnumRegs
methods.description: Generates C++ enum registration code for enums, including conversion tables.

methods.name: EmitObjects
methods.description: Generates C++ code for JSON objects, classes, enums, and related structures, handling nested classes and code validation.
